text:
sarah_m: Quick follow-up thread for the postmortem action items from the recent quota/autoscale outage. Focus: quota throttles, scheduler tuning, headroom knobs, and short-term mitigations. Who owns what + ETA?

jordan_r: I'll take quota throttling policy design. Proposal: per-tenant burst tokens (bucketed) + a soft cap that degrades to 50% throughput for noisy tenants. Draft policy by Monday.

anya: I'll update the postmortem with the recurring-failure section (pattern recognition) and add the runbook play steps for emergency headroom reserve. Target: docs + runbook PR by Tue EOD.

leo_ops: Scheduler changes: two small items: 1) add a low-latency priorityClass for inference pods, 2) modify reclaim behavior to prefer preempting batch jobs flagged best-effort. I can prototype kube-scheduler config and open PR by Thu.

olivia_pm: Monitoring ask: add a lead indicator metric "scale_failures_per_minute" and an anomaly alert on prediction mismatch (predicted capacity vs actual). Need that before any threshold changes go to canary.

sam_s: I'll own the canary plan + fast rollback scripts. Canary window: 4h on a subset of customers (5% traffic). I have a checklist for rollback and warmup. Canary ready once sims look good.

jordan_r: Short-term mitigation idea: ephemeral pre-warm GPUs that spin up for high-rate bursts (TTL 10m). Could be auto-reaped. Risk: cost leak if TTL mis-set.

sarah_m: Good idea. Add cost guard rails (global ttl cap + automation to reclaim older pre-warms).

jordan_r: Simulator command I'm using to reproduce the spike:
```
./replay --trace traces/july-spike-2026.json --scale 8 --cold-cache
```

sam_s: When you run that, include a run where we enable pre-warm pool of 8 GPUs and one where we don't. Capture p99 latency and number of scale events.

leo_ops: Headroom knob request: expose reserved_pool_percent via infra config (default 0). I'll file infra-ops ticket and link here. ETA PR next Wed.

anya: Runbook addition: if autoscaler fails 2x in 30m, trigger tenant soft-throttles + enable pre-warm pool and notify paging. I'll add exact commands.

infra-bot: Reminder: infra maintenance scheduled Friday 02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary windows should avoid that.

olivia_pm: Customer messaging: we'll prepare a one-paragraph note explaining the mitigation and timeline. anya, can you draft a template?

anya: Yup. I'll share a draft in #customer-updates by Tue.

jordan_r: Owner summary to put into the ticket: jordan_r -> throttling policy + pre-warm prototype (Mon), leo_ops -> scheduler + reserved_pool PR (Wed), sam_s -> canary plan + rollback scripts (after sims), anya -> runbook + messaging (Tue), olivia_pm -> monitoring alerts and alert thresholds (before canary).

sarah_m: Timeline looks good. We'll do a quick sync Thu morning to review sim numbers and decide on canary. Set a calendar for 30m. Thanks all. :calendar:
